review: Reviewed 167 logical drawings from the original four-building pack (42, 53, 35 and 37 respectively). Matched 237 printed total rows against OCR of the rendered source area tables and visually confirmed five clipped numeric panels. Cross-checked the printed title and type variants, including irregular plurals and the APARTEMNT typo on page 44. Kept the complete original PDF and each layout’s title, table, diagram, logos and disclaimer.
unavailable: Precise Lamaa building entrance coordinates were unavailable. The directions link uses the project name.
